paragraphs: There was a young man, not very deep in his thinking, who made a habit of running down the Hindu scriptures whenever he was with Sri Ramakrishna.
Then one day, out of the blue, he began praising the Bhagavad Gita.
Sri Ramakrishna gently teased him. Some European scholar, he guessed, must have praised the Gita, so this young man was now simply following along.
learn: Borrowed opinions, whether they reject something or praise it, are not real understanding. Before you dismiss or celebrate an idea, study it yourself and form your own view.
